name: Stive-Bentley Keumajou
strengths: Keumajou shows strong initial quickness off the snap and bursts into gaps before blockers set.
Keumajou plays with good leverage and pad level for nearly 300 pounds, driving blockers on contact.
Keumajou pursues laterally with surprising agility for a 295-pound interior and finishes in space.
Keumajou works through double teams with a hot motor and play recognition beyond a one-year football background.
weaknesses: Keumajou still needs a fuller pass-rush plan -- too often power-only without refined hand counters.
comparison: Keumajou comps to Teair Tart -- compact ~6-2 / 300 interior DL who wins with leverage, power, and gap integrity (size-matched to Keumajou's 6-2.5 / 295 mold).
projection: Keumajou projects as develop into the DL room, earn early rotational nose/1-tech snaps as a run stuffer, then compete for a starting interior role -- starter upside as a high-floor gap eater if hands catch up.
schemeFit: Keumajou fits White as a nose/1-tech who can also shade 3-tech in even fronts.
insiderNotes: Keumajou bursts into gaps before blockers set and plays with leverage for nearly 300 pounds. Lateral agility and a hot motor through double teams — high-floor interior power with developmental hands.
staffNotes: Vault film desk verified 2026-08-05 from Hudl mid-szn tape. Comp size-matched within ~1-2" -- not a Florida-alum default.
recruitingStory: Stive-Bentley Keumajou is a 3-star DL | listed 6-2.5 / 295 | Coral Gables Senior (FL) | Florida 2027 commit.
angle: Lead with Coral Gables mid-season leverage, burst, and motor on the interior.
